name: Assistant · Messenger and Lead Ads in
description: Receives Facebook Page messages and Lead Ads form submissions and hands them to Ingest message.

parameters.content:
## Messenger and Lead Ads
Events of the Facebook Page (one webhook per Page in a Meta app). When the workflow is published, the trigger subscribes the Meta app to Page events (`messages`, `messaging_postbacks`, `leadgen`) with this webhook and checks each event's signature with the app secret. The Page itself is subscribed once by `scripts/meta-setup.mjs`.
A message is turned into the common format and stored by **Ingest message**. A Lead Ads form submission is read in full (**Get lead**) and stored the same way; the assistant's first reply goes to the lead's phone on WhatsApp.
